verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents a Private Cloud offering: a dedicated, isolated, Auth0-managed instance on AWS or Azure aimed at data-residency requirements (auth0-docs-14, auth0-docs-48, auth0-docs-64). Custom database connections to an external user store are mentioned, but only in a migration (import mode) context (auth0-docs-10), and there is no evidence of a self-managed or self-hosted deployment. Private Cloud is still run by Auth0, so control is limited to choosing a vendor-managed private instance. Missing for 10: self-managed/on-prem deployment option, explicit docs on keeping user data permanently in your own database (not just migrating it), and independent corroboration of the data-residency controls.
